method: Fisher v2b: Gaussian diagonal Fisher on PTA free-spectrum bins. mu_k = P(f_k|A,gamma) = A^2 (f_k/fref)^-gamma. var_k = (sigma_base_frac*P_fid(f_k))^2 * alpha_noise. Only var scales with scenario; dmu/dtheta depends only on signal. F_ij = sum_k dmu_i dmu_j / var_k.

NG20_est.interpretation: ~5 more yr of current PTA (half the noise variance)

CPTA_2030.interpretation: CPTA full sensitivity, 1/5 noise variance of NG15

SKA_PTA_2035.interpretation: SKA-class PTA, 1/20 noise variance of NG15

notes: Supersedes fisher_result.json which scaled full C and saw zero change in sigma(gamma). v2b scales only the noise variance, so future PTAs correctly tighten sigma(gamma) monotonically.
